moments.label: Splash screen 'RAID SHADOW LEGENDS: THE SHARD MARKET IS OPENING' at 100%.
Tutorial prompt 'DRAG TO MOVE · STOCK THE SHARD MARKET' with hand pointing at yellow circle near shards.
Character drags to the green crystal patch and collects a glowing stack of 28+ shards onto their back.
Character carries 35 shards across the courtyard and dumps them into the market bin as customers line up.
Character steps onto the golden carpet to collect 46 gold bars earned from shard sales.
Character follows the tutorial hand down-left around the stone portal building.
Tutorial hand highlights the 10-gold pickaxe upgrade pad on the left.
Character steps onto the 10 pad, spends gold, hires the first miner, and reveals the 40, 50, and 1,500 pads.
Character heads up-right to the glowing crystal pile while the newly hired worker begins mining.
Character gathers a massive towering stack of 91 glowing green shards onto their back.
Character hauls the 91-shard stack to the market bin and stocks it in one huge drop-off.
Character collects a tall stack of 89 gold bars from the blue-and-gold market carpet.
Character carries 89 gold bars past the stone portal building, revealing the 1,500-gold tower unlock pad.
Character approaches the 40, 50, and 1,500 upgrade pads and pauses on the 50 crystal pad.
Character moves back and forth between the 50 crystal pad and 40 pickaxe pad without triggering an upgrade.
Character steps onto the 40 pickaxe pad, spends gold down to 49, and hires a second miner as the pad upgrades to 65.
Character moves near the 50 crystal pad and 65 pickaxe pad as the recording ends.

game.title: Raid: Shard Market
game.objective: Mine green shards, stock the market bin for customers to buy, collect gold, and hire workers or upgrade the mine.
game.controls: Drag anywhere on screen to move the character with a virtual joystick.
game.core_loop: Collect green shards from the mine, carry them to the market bin to sell to customers, collect the earned gold, and spend it on worker and mine upgrades.
game.progression: Unlocking and upgrading worker pads (10 -> 40 -> 65 gold) to automate mining, alongside higher-tier mine (50 gold) and tower (1,500 gold) unlocks.
game.hook_idea: t=45.2-54.6s: Gathering and hauling a towering glowing stack of 91 green shards through the dungeon into the market bin.
